full_text:
The Gargoyle trap was a mechanical trap that guarded the Cave of the Gargoyle in order to prevent Gar-Ghoul's Amulet from being recovered.

History

The Gargoyle attacked the Dante Vale's team and DeFoe's army in the Cave of the Gargoyle where a large battle took place. It caused many Titans to return to their Amulets, including Sabriel, Strix, and Kipperin. Lok Lambert scanned the trap with his Holotome and revealed that this was a type of magical trap instead of a Titan. Sophie Casterwill then destroyed the trap with Breakspell. [Into the River of Secrets]

Abilities

The Gargoyle trap has the equivalent of an attack power of 0 and a defense power of 1. [SAS-071] This trap can shoot jets of water from its mouth with an incredible force to easily defeat Titans and injure Seekers. Dante Vale noted that at the speed the water was travelling, it could hit like a bullet. [Into the River of Secrets]
